sections.name: Hook
lines: v_hook
When you press play, the video isn't sent as one big file. It arrives in tiny pieces, a few seconds at a time.
v_title
Here's what's behind every play button, in five steps.

sections.name: Chopped into chunks
lines: v_chunks
Step one. Before you ever watch it, the video is chopped into short chunks, each just a few seconds long.
v_ladder
Every chunk is stored in several versions, from low quality, all the way up to sharp HD and beyond.
v_why
Small chunks mean you can start watching straight away, and skip ahead without downloading the whole thing.

sections.name: A server near you
lines: v_cdn
Step two. Copies of popular videos sit on servers spread around the world, often in a building not far from you.
v_close
Your request goes to the nearest one, not some faraway headquarters. Shorter trip, faster start.
v_isp
Some services even put their own servers inside your internet provider's network.

sections.name: Filling the buffer
lines: v_buffer
Step three. Your app downloads chunks ahead of what you're watching, and keeps them ready in a buffer.
v_ahead
On a good connection, the buffer holds plenty of video, so a short hiccup goes unnoticed.
v_spin
If chunks arrive slower than you watch, the buffer runs dry, and you get the spinning wheel.

sections.name: Picking the quality
lines: v_measure
Step four. The app keeps measuring how fast the chunks are arriving.
v_switch
Fast connection? It grabs the sharp version of the next chunk. Slow? It drops to a lower one, so the video keeps playing.
v_start
That's why a video can look blurry for a moment, then snap into focus.

sections.name: Squeezed small
lines: v_squeeze
Step five. Each chunk is heavily compressed. Mostly, it stores only what changes from one frame to the next.
v_together
Then your device unpacks each chunk, and plays them back to back, so smoothly you never see the seams.

sections.name: Recap
lines: w_recap
Chopped into chunks. Stored near you. Buffered ahead. The quality adapts to your connection, and every chunk is squeezed small.
outro
Next time it buffers, you'll know your buffer just ran dry. Follow for more of the tech you use every day.
